channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Wadahadalka xisbiyada ee doorashada oo dib u furmaya Isniinta si loo ansixiyo go'aannada
item.description: Hoggaamiyeyaasha xisbiyada siyaasadda ee Koonfur Suudaan ayaa ku heshiiyay inay Isniinta, 9 November, dib ugu kulmaan Juba si ay u dhammaystiraan una ansixiyaan go'aannada wadahadalka la xiriira doorashada ka hor doorashooyinka guud ee December 2026, sida uu sheegay xafiiska Xoghayaha Guud ee SPLM. Taariikhda xafladda xiritaanka ayaa la go'aamin doonaa iyadoo lala tashanayo Madaxweyne Salva Kiir.

item.title: Lionel Messi oo noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay ee MLS Golden Boot ku guuleysta labo xilli oo xiriir ah
item.description: Lionel Messi oo u ciyaara Inter Miami ayaa 26 gool ku dhaliyay 31 kulan, isagoo noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay taariikhda MLS ee abaalmarinta Golden Boot ku guuleysta labo xilli oo isku xiga, sida uu werisay Nile Post isagoo soo xiganaya BBC Sport. Messi oo 39 jir ah ayaa sidoo kale sameeyay 17 caawin.

item.title: Museveni oo maalgashadayaasha Talyaaniga ugu baaqay inay Uganda ka maalgeliyaan warshadaynta
item.description: Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni ayaa Entebbe kula kulmay wafdi ka badan 80 qof oo ka socda Talyaaniga, wuxuuna ugu baaqay inay maalgeliyaan warshadaha qaxwada iyo baytariyada lithium, sida ay werisay Nile Post. Ra'iisul wasaare Robinah Nabbanja ayaa sheegtay in Talyaanigu u qoondeeyay 120 milyan oo euro qaybta qaxwada Uganda, waxaana kulanka lagu saxiixay heshiis iskaashi horumarineed.

item.title: Mareykanka oo sameeyay koox hawleed lagu xannibayo waddooyinka sahayda dhulka ee Iiraan
item.description: Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay inuu sameeyay koox hawleed cusub oo la yiraahdo Task Force Iron Gate, oo looga golleeyahay joojinta hubka iyo alaabta cunaqabateynta saaran ee mara xuduudaha dhulka ee Iiraan iyo Badda Caspian. CENTCOM ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in tan iyo July 147 markab ganacsi loo leexiyay, halka warbaahinta Iiraan ay werisay qaraxyo ka dhacay jasiiradda Qeshm iyo magaalooyin xeebeed.

item.title: Jasiiradda El Hierro ee Canary oo ku dhawaaqday xaalad degdeg ah kadib kororka muhaajiriinta
item.description: Maamulka jasiiradda El Hierro ee Isbaanish ayaa ku dhawaaqay xaalad degdeg ah oo caawimo ka codsaday dowladda Madrid, kadib markii in ka badan 3,300 oo muhaajiriin ah ay ku yimaadeen ilaa 30 doon tan iyo bilowga November, sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha deegaanka. Jasiiraddu waxay leedahay ku dhawaad 11,400 oo qof oo deggan.

item.title: La Liga: Real Madrid oo Valencia kaga badisay 3-0 garoonka Mestalla
item.description: Real Madrid ayaa Sabtidii 3-0 kaga adkaatay Valencia garoonka Mestalla, iyadoo goolasha ay dhaliyeen Federico Valverde, Arda Güler iyo Kylian Mbappé, sida ay werisay Yahoo Sports, natiijadaas oo ay sidoo kale xaqiijisay VAVEL. Guushan, oo ahayd tii siddeedaad oo xiriir ah, ayaa Real Madrid dhibcaha kula siman ka dhigtay Barcelona oo hoggaanka La Liga haysa.

item.title: Madaxweynaha Israa'iil oo Gadi Eisenkot u doortay dhisidda dowladda, halkii Netanyahu
item.description: Madaxweynaha Israa'iil Isaac Herzog ayaa Gadi Eisenkot, hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Yashar, u xilsaaray inuu dhiso dowladda xigta, kadib markii 67 xildhibaan ay taageereen halka Netanyahu uu helay 46, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Eisenkot wuxuu haystaa 28 maalmood, oo 14 maalmood lagu kordhin karo, si uu u helo ugu yaraan 61 kursi oo ka mid ah 120-ka kursi ee Knesset-ka.

item.title: Faransiiska: in ka badan 140,000 oo qof oo ka dibadbaxay kororka qiimaha nolosha
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Faransiiska ayaa sheegtay in ku dhawaad 146,000 oo qof, oo 46,000 ka mid ah ay joogeen Paris, ay Sabtidii dalka oo dhan ka dibadbaxeen kororka qiimaha nolosha, halka ururrada shaqaaluhu ay sheegeen 250,000. Booliiska ayaa Paris iyo Lyon ku isticmaalay sun dadka ilmeysiisa, waxaana tani ahayd todobaadkii afraad oo xiriir ah ee dibadbaxyada.

item.title: Tennis: Carlos Alcaraz oo Casper Ruud ka badiyay, finalka Paris Masters wuxuu la ciyaarayaa Ben Shelton
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz ayaa semi-finalka Paris Masters kaga adkaaday Casper Ruud 6-4, 6-4, halka Ben Shelton uu Luca Van Assche ka badiyay 5-7, 6-3, 6-4, sida ay werisay ESPN, natiijooyinkaas oo ay sidoo kale xaqiijisay ATP Tour. Alcaraz ayaa sheegay inuu doonayo inuu Shelton ka aar gooyo, kaddib markii uu kaga guuldarraystay kulankoodii u dambeeyay ee US Open.

item.title: Mareykanka oo ballan qaaday abaal-marin ilaa $20 milyan ah oo loogu talagalay xog ku saabsan barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran
item.description: Barnaamijka Rewards for Justice ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa ku dhawaaqay abaal-marin ilaa $20 milyan ah iyo suurtagalnimada in la raraan qofka keena xog ku saabsan barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran, sida ay werisay BBC. Iran ayaa ku adkaysata in barnaamijkeedu yahay mid nabadeed oo aysan dooneynin hub nukliyeer.

item.title: Baabe Leo XIV oo cibaadadiisii ugu horreysay ka qabtay Uruguay, inta lagu jiro socdaal Laatiin Ameerika
item.description: Baabe Leo XIV ayaa Sabtidii cibaado ka qabtay magaalada Paysandu ee galbeedka Uruguay, taas oo ay ka soo qeybgaleen ku dhawaad 40,000 oo qof sida ay sheegtay Vatican-ka, iyadoo qayb ka ah socdaal 12 maalmood ah oo uu ku marayo Laatiin Ameerika. Booqashadan ayaa timid kadib qalliin sambabada ah oo lagu sameeyay bishii hore, waxaana uu Axadda u gudbayaa Argentina.

item.title: Arsenal oo 1-0 ku garaacday Hull City goolkii dambe ee Martin Ødegaard
item.description: Arsenal ayaa Sabtidii garoonka Emirates ku garaacday Hull City 1-0 ciyaar Premier League ah, iyadoo kaptan Martin Ødegaard uu goolka dhaliyay daqiiqaddii 72-aad kadib markii uu ka faa'iideystay laad uu tuuray Noni Madueke, sida ay wariyeen BBC Sport iyo Fox Sports.

item.title: All Blacks oo 43-21 ku garaacday Scotland garoonka Murrayfield
item.description: Xulka rugby-ga New Zealand ayaa Sabtidii Edinburgh ku garaacay Scotland 43-21 tartanka Nations Championship, iyagoo dhaliyay toddobo try halka Scotland ay dhalisay saddex, sida ay wariyeen BBC Sport iyo bogga rasmiga ah ee All Blacks. Scotland oo qeybtii hore saddex dhibcood oo keliya ka hoosaysay ayaan qeybtii labaad wax dhibic ah keenin.

item.title: Poland: Ugu yaraan 6 qof oo lagu dilay rasaas ka dhacday fagaaraha suuqa weyn ee Krakow
item.description: Booliiska Krakow ayaa sheegay in nin hubaysan oo baabuur wata uu Sabtidii rasaas ku furay dadka ku sugnaa fagaaraha suuqa weyn ee magaalada, isagoo dilay ugu yaraan 6 qof, halka 15 kale ay ku dhaawacmeen, sida ay werisay CNN. Booliiska ayaa sheegay in tuhmanaha la toogtay oo la dhaawacay, isbitaalna la geeyay.

item.title: F1: Hamilton iyo Verstappen oo ka bilaabanaya gadaasha safka Grand Prix-ga São Paulo
item.description: Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) iyo Max Verstappen (Red Bull) ayaa tartanka Axadda ee São Paulo Grand Prix ka bilaabi doona dhammaadka safka, kadib markii baabuurtooda lagu rakibay matoor cusub oo dhammaystiran, sida ay werisay BBC Sport. Charles Leclerc ayaa helay ciqaab 10 boos ah, George Russell-na 5 boos.

item.title: Doorashada New Zealand oo aan lahayn guuleyste cad kadib natiijooyin aad isugu dhow
item.description: Natiijooyinka hordhaca ah ee doorashadii Sabtida ayaa muujinaya in xisbiga National ee Ra'iisul Wasaare Christopher Luxon uu helay 42 kursi, oo 19 ka yar inta loo baahan yahay, halka xisbiga Labour ee Chris Hipkins uu helay 36, sida ay werisay BBC. Labada dhinac ayaa u diyaar garoobaya wadahadallo isbahaysi oo laga yaabo inay toddobaadyo qaataan.

item.title: Trump oo Stephen Miller u magacaabay madaxa shaqaalaha Aqalka Cad
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Stephen Miller, oo ahaa ku-xigeenka madaxa shaqaalaha isla markaana dejiyay siyaasadda adag ee socdaalka, u magacaabay inuu beddelo Susie Wiles, kadib khasaaraha taariikhiga ah ee Xisbiga Jamhuuriga ka soo gaaray doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe, sida ay werisay France 24.

item.title: Kenya: Wax-soo-saarka sonkorta oo kordhay 56.7% iyadoo qiimuhu hoos u dhacay
item.description: Xogta Guddiga Sonkorta Kenya ayaa muujisay in warshadaha gudaha ay soo saareen 690,521 tan oo sonkor ah intii u dhaxaysay January iyo September 2026, marka la barbardhigo 440,652 tan oo xilligaas la mid ah sannadkii hore, sida ay werisay Capital FM. Celceliska qiimaha tafaariiqda ayaa September 2026 hoos ugu dhacay Sh155 halkii kiilo, halka uu ahaa Sh171 September 2025.

item.title: Ingiriiska oo muwaadiniintiisa uga digay safarka Moyale kadib rabshadaha xadka Itoobiya
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Ingiriiska (FCDO) ayaa 6 November muwaadiniinteeda kula talisay inay ka fogaadaan safar aan lagama maarmaan ahayn oo ay ku tagaan magaalada Moyale iyo 5 kiiloomitir oo ku wareegsan xadka Kenya iyo Itoobiya, iyadoo ku sababaysay rabshadaha Itoobiya ee saameeyay dhinaca Kenya, sida ay werisay Capital FM. Taliyaha Booliiska Kenya Douglas Kanja ayaa 5 November booqasho amni ku tagay Moyale, wuxuuna sheegay in Kenya ay la xiriirtay Itoobiya si colaadda loo soo afjaro, sida ay qortay Addis Standard.

item.title: Wau: Maamulka gobolka oo xiray xafiisyada laba shirkadood oo diyaaradeed khilaaf canshuur $5 ah
item.description: Maamulka gobolka Western Bahr el Ghazal ee Koonfur Suudaan ayaa xiray xafiisyada shirkadaha Kush Airlines iyo Arojet Airlines ee magaalada Wau, kadib markii ay diideen inay ka qaadaan rakaabka canshuur tigidh oo 5 doolar ah, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj. Mas'uuliyiinta gobolka ayaa sheegay in canshuurtu sharci ku salaysan tahay, isla markaana ay bixiyaan rakaabka ee aysan ahayn shirkadaha.

item.title: Kenya: McDonald Mariga oo laga qaaday jagada ku-xigeenka guddoomiyaha FKF
item.description: Shir guud oo gaar ah oo Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Kenya (FKF) Sabtidii ku yeeshay Meru ayaa 65 ergo ay u codeeyeen in xilka laga qaado ku-xigeenka guddoomiyaha McDonald Mariga, oo ahaa xiddigii hore ee Inter Milan, iyo 6 xubnood oo kale oo ka tirsan Guddiga Fulinta Qaranka, sida ay werisay Capital FM. Guddoomiyaha AFC Leopards Boniface Ambani ayaa ahaa qofka keliya ee ka soo horjeestay.

item.title: Kenya: Paul Mackenzie oo lagu xukumay 200 sano oo xabsi ah dilkii Shakahola
item.description: Maxkamad ku taal Kenya ayaa Jimcihii hoggaamiyaha kooxda diimeed Paul Mackenzie ku xukuntay 200 sano oo xabsi ah, kadib markii lagu helay dhimashada 190 carruur ah oo gaajo iyo dil loogu geystay kaynta Shakahola, sida ay werisay Daily Sabah. Garsoore Diana Kavedza ayaa sheegtay in xukunku ka kooban yahay 100 sano oo dil gaajo ah iyo 100 sano oo dil toos ah.

item.title: Tanzania oo heshay 1.2 bilyan oo doolar oo lagu dhisayo qaybta Tabora–Kigoma ee tareenka SGR
item.description: Tanzania ayaa heshay maalgelin dhan 1.2 bilyan oo doolar oo uu soo abaabulay Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika (AfDB), taasoo lagu dhisi doono qaybta 411 kiiloomitir ee Tabora–Kigoma ee jidka tareenka SGR, sida ay werisay The Citizen. Heshiiska oo ay ku jiraan 9 bangi ayaa qayb ka ah xirmo maalgelin oo dhan 2.3 bilyan oo doolar, waxaana ku jira dammaanad 800 milyan oo doolar ah oo AfDB bixisay.

item.title: Cricket: Usman Khawaja oo sheegay in kooxda Australia oo dhan ay ogaayeen fadeexaddii kubadda ee 2018
item.description: Ciyaaryahankii hore ee Australia Usman Khawaja ayaa wargeyska The Sydney Morning Herald u sheegay in dhammaan kooxdu ay ogaayeen qorshihii kubadda lagu xoqay ee 2018 ee loo yaqaan 'Sandpapergate', sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Cricket Australia ayaa sheegtay inay ku qanacsan tahay natiijadii baaritaankeedii hore, balse ay tixgelin doonto caddeyn kasta oo cusub.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo Wajahaysa Isgoys Halis ah: Ma Laga Baran Doonaa Casharradii Liibiya iyo Suudaan?
item.description: Khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan arrimaha Dastuurka, Doorashooyinka iyo loollanka awoodda, ayaa halis gelin kara xasilloonida dalka. Waxaa jirta cabsi laga qabo in dalalka shisheeye ay ka faa’iidaystaan kala qaybsanaanta gudaha, sida ka dhacday Liibiya iyo Suudaan. Soomaalida waxaa looga digayaa inay ka heshiiyaan khilaafaadkooda siyaasadeed, kana hortagaan dagaal sokeeye iyo faragelin shisheeye oo halis gelin karta mustaqbalka dalka.

item.title: Europa League: Kamada oo daqiiqaddii ugu dambeysay Crystal Palace u badbaadiyay 1-1 ka dhan ah Hoffenheim
item.description: Crystal Palace ayaa 1-1 la gashay Hoffenheim, kadib markii Daichi Kamada uu gool ku dhaliyay daqiiqadda 90+1, Alexander Prass-na uu Hoffenheim hogaanka u qabtay daqiiqadda 7, sida ay werisay Bundesliga.com. Ciyaaraha kale ee Khamiista, Milan ayaa 0-2 gurigeeda looga adkaaday Ferencváros, halka Bournemouth ay Sparta Praha kaga adkaatay 1-3, sida ay muujinayso liiska natiijooyinka ee UEFA.

item.title: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo oo sheegay inuu riday gantaal loo ganay gobolka Madiina
item.description: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay inuu dhex-qabtay oo burburiyay gantaal ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay u ganeen dhanka gobolka Madiina, kadib markii hay'adda difaaca madaniga ay ka digtay khatar ka jirta agagaarka dekedda Yanbu, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Xuutiyiinta ayaa beeniyay in ay bartilmaameedsanayeen magaalada, iyagoo eedeyntaas ku tilmaamay been abuur.

item.title: George Russell oo sheegay inuu si qoto dheer isu qiimeyn doono kadib xilli ciyaareed niyad jab ah
item.description: Darawalka Mercedes George Russell ayaa sheegay inuu si qoto dheer isu eegi doono si uu u ogaado sida uu u horumarin karo kadib xilli ciyaareedka 2026 oo uu ku tilmaamay mid niyad jab ah, sida ay werisay BBC Sport. Russell wuxuu ku guuleystay 3 tartan oo keliya, halka saaxiibkiisa kooxda Kimi Antonelli uu ku guuleystay 9 tartan isagoo noqday horyaalka ugu da'da yar taariikhda Formula 1.

item.title: Guddoomiyaha California Newsom oo xukunnada dilka ee 548 maxbuus u beddelay xabsi daa'im
item.description: Guddoomiyaha gobolka California Gavin Newsom ayaa xukunnada dilka ee dhammaan 548-ka qof ee gobolkaas ku xukunnaa dil u beddelay xabsi daa'im ah, sida ay werisay BBC. Go'aanka ayaa inta badan loo arkaa mid calaamad ah, maadaama California aysan qof dil ku fulin tan iyo 2006, waxaana uu yimid xilli Newsom loo tilmaamayo musharax suurtagal ah.

item.title: Iiraan oo sheegtay in markab-shidaal dhowr ah ay ku gubteen Marinka Hormuz
item.description: Ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iiraan ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan 5 markab oo shidaal qaada iyo doon jiid ah ay dab ku qabsaday dhacdooyin kala duwan oo ka dhacay Marinka Hormuz, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Iiraan ayaa sheegtay in mid ka mid ah maraakiibta uu ku dhacay miino, xilli dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israa'iil ay la galeen Iiraan uu weli xal la'aan yahay.
